abstract_en: Online lecture series of the University of Duisburg-Essen introducing the key debates on identity and diversity categories; the introduction to the Aurora micro-credential "Identities and Diversities".
description_en: Scholars of the University of Duisburg-Essen, researchers and community stakeholders introduce diversity concepts in a global context, interdisciplinary theory and the interpretation of intersectional experience, with reference to the targets of SDG 10.
learning_outcomes_en: Explain diversity concepts in a global context; relate them to the targets of SDG 10; apply interdisciplinary theory; interpret intersectional experience.

title_en: BIP: All Aboard: Inclusive Language Teaching and Learning
abstract_en: Blended Intensive Programme of the University of Duisburg-Essen for future language teachers: creating learning environments where every student feels welcome, supported and able to succeed.
description_en: An online week (22 to 26 February 2027) followed by an in-person week at the University of Helsinki (8 to 12 March 2027). Topics: diversity, equity and inclusion, multilingualism, accessible digital learning, gamification, learning differences and nonbinary language.

abstract_en: Blended course of the University of Duisburg-Essen on the sustainability challenges Europe faces in the 21st century, ending with a student conference in Amsterdam.
description_en: Teams of four or five students from different Aurora universities research one topic linked to a Sustainable Development Goal and present it at the conference in Amsterdam from 9 to 11 June 2027. The 2027 tracks are Sustainable Tourism (theme parks) and The New European City.
learning_outcomes_en: Identify theoretical models; explain viewpoints; list and compare solutions to a European sustainability challenge.
assessment_en: An oral presentation at the conference and a research paper.
